notes.title: v. 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Hi all, and welcome to the launch of Lost in Static. We hope everyone is having a great holiday season, and is prepared to experience the horrors inside the liminal space. After a day out, your daughter has gone mysteriously missing. Your mission? Find your daughter, and get out. Within Lost In Static, you will not only find the familiar yellow wallpaper of the backrooms, but also urban decay of an abandoned mall. You never know what will perk around each corner, continue with caution. 

Make sure to review the game once you've tried it. It  helps out immensely! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181719/9e4c2934b91061929f5b0bc8d9816fdb00c93ecf.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181719/83f1d6ec94dbc15bf4bb7ad2be0381bc9b4c5c54.jpg

Some things to look out for in the upcoming weeks…. 

– Gamepad compatibility. Post launch we are committed to ensuring we have full support for the Xbox Controller gamepad. 
– We will continue to look out for bugs. Keep us posted if you have any issues and we will do our best to fix them. 
–  Quality of life updates, and achievement implementation.
